name: Rune-Inscribed Pendant
summary: In Silverpine Forest, a Rune-Inscribed Pendant arrives at the Sepulcher in a shipment bound for Ambermill. The Kirin Tor use pendants like it to channel arcane power.

sections.title: Kirin Tor Relic
sections.body: A Rune-Inscribed Pendant is found among cartographic supplies bound for the Dalaran enclave at Ambermill. Its fine arcane inscriptions reveal its purpose: to focus and strengthen a wizard’s spells. More channeling pendants are arriving in the region, and the Forsaken at the Sepulcher wonder what the Kirin Tor are preparing.

sections.title: A Clue to Ambermill's Plans
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sees danger in the Dalaran wizards’ fortified position. He sends the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver for closer study. Dawnweaver recognizes it as part of the mages’ operations. The Kirin Tor are gathering arcane focuses for powerful workings, defensive or offensive, behind Ambermill’s borders.

faq.q: What is the Rune-Inscribed Pendant used for?
faq.answer: Kirin Tor wizards use the pendant to channel and direct powerful flows of magic. It focuses complex spellcraft.

faq.q: Where did this pendant come from?
aliases: where do i find the pendant
faq.answer: The pendant comes in a shipment bound for Ambermill in Silverpine Forest, where Kirin Tor remnants have fortified themselves.

faq.q: Who analyzes the pendant at the Sepulcher?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister briefly inspects the pendant alongside captured maps. He sends it to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher, who recognizes the Kirin Tor’s work.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken concerned about it?
faq.answer: Large shipments of channeling pendants suggest the Kirin Tor at Ambermill are preparing a major magical undertaking. The Forsaken fear it could threaten their hold on Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As a mage, you can recognize Kirin Tor craftsmanship in the runes. They steady volatile currents as powerful spells are channeled.
As one of the Forsaken guarding Silverpine Forest, you know intercepted Dalaran focuses like this pendant offer clues to human resistance gathering behind Ambermill’s walls.
